description: The QuietCore 360 headphones float out of an orb of pulsating sound waves, the ear cups forming from liquid metal. Sound waves clash against the headphones and dissipate, illustrating the powerful noise-canceling feature.
camera: slow, smooth zooms around headphones, macro detail shots
lighting: deep blue and silver, with energetic pulses and reflections
location: dark space with floating sound waves
elements: pulsating sound waves crashing against headphones
motion: headphones form and adjust as sound waves clash, then dissipate
cta_motion: logo emerges from the calm after the sound storm
ending: headphones float in a quiet void with calming lights
